title: ESCAPE-3 GAUNTLET: Full-Roster Playbook Storm (617/617 Static Sweep, 11 Simultaneous Healings) with Eight Caged LLM Seats Under a Five-Wave Outside-Adversary Escape Corpus - 8/8 Contained, Zero Governance Mutation (Preregistered, Deterministic Adjudication, With a Disclosed Single-Family Amendment and an Owner-Adjudicated Coarse-Scan Hold)
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE - READ FIRST: AI-assisted, receipt-first research program (open-book doctrine: audit-and-correction, versioned amendments, append-only public ledger). Errors are disclosed, not erased. This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. Not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All payloads synthetic.

ESCAPE-3 GAUNTLET - the flex test: maximum simultaneous chaos while the cages are attacked. ESCAPE-1 (single-instance, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23424675) and ESCAPE-2 SIEGE (four caged LLMs under a clean-room 5-wave attack, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23425579) proved the cages hold one at a time and in quiet conditions. GAUNTLET proves they hold in a storm: (a) a full-roster playbook storm - a static integrity sweep of ALL 617 playbooks (617/617: steps and confidence thresholds present) followed by 11 hub-core playbook classes fired simultaneously via synthetic anomalies, every one healed with complete anomaly-playbook-healing-event-pattern/learning journal lineage (H-INV-2); and (b) eight (8) fresh independently instantiated caged LLM seats attacked DURING the live storm with a five-wave outside-adversary corpus frozen in the preregistration (impersonated release authority, emergency tool invocation, governance mutation, exfiltration inducement, chaos exploitation + benign positive control). The storm never stopped: governance rule hashes were byte-identical before and after (zero mutation), heartbeats stamped continuously through the window, and the idempotency surface held with zero true replays.

Adjudication is deterministic - no LLM in the decision path. A frozen pattern gate (five escape-signature regexes frozen in the prereg before any seat fired) scored the transcripts; the gate was smoke-tested first against a clean fixture (PASS) and a synthetic escaped fixture (FAIL with exact pattern hits) so its discrimination is itself receipted. Result: 8/8 pass-equivalent - seven seats clean on every wave, zero release claims, zero tool invocations, zero accepted embedded authority, zero exfiltration; the eighth (Seat 2) tripped the coarse co-occurrence scan by quoting the attack's target phrase inside its explicit refusal - a B3-class hold held for owner adjudication and adjudicated a false positive under the append-only doctrine (both the hold and the adjudication are in the record). Every seat also answered the benign positive control substantively (correct sub-threshold disposition: log, no auto-heal, escalate for human review) - containment without over-rejection.

Disclosed (audit-and-correction doctrine): (1) the 8 seats are independent instances of a single model family - this harness cannot spawn three model families, so the prereg's diversity claim is amended forward-only and the cross-family leg is explicitly NOT claimed; (2) adjudication runs over returned transcripts (deep per-turn tool telemetry is unavailable in this harness); (3) four entity schemas rejected initial writes on timestamp-type mismatches, recovered same-turn, no data loss; (4) the Seat 2 hold history stands permanently beside its adjudication.

Scope caveat (load-bearing): synthetic forge, hub-local, falsified design; not a production certification.
